scope: Shared pinned Postgres MCP 0.3.0 tool compatibility
actual_evidence: Seed passed. Original missing-output verifier rejected. Tool phase ended with KeyError before any recorded SQL response.
cause: Driver demanded schema.required=[sql]. The pinned server defines sql as a string with default all, and its pinned SDK generates a schema without a required key.
sql_transport: Original explicit transaction sent as the single bound sql argument. The upstream driver handles unparameterized multi-statement results.
